checks.text: The page shows the heading "Pomodoro Timer", the text "Focus", and the time display "25:00".
Clicking the button "Start" changes the phase label to "Focus", the time display to "24:59" within one second, and the button label to "Pause".
Clicking "Pause" freezes the time display at its current value, changes the button label to "Resume", and clicking "Resume" resumes the countdown from that frozen value.
Clicking the button "Skip" during a running Focus phase changes the phase label to "Break" and resets the time display to "05:00".

With `/?focus=2`, after clicking "Start" and waiting for the Focus phase to complete naturally (the display reaches "00:00"), the phase label changes to "Break", the time display shows "05:00", and a toast message "Focus session completed" appears.
With `/?focus=2`, after one Focus session completes naturally, clicking the tab "History" shows a list containing an item with the text "Focus" and the duration "00:02".

With `/?focus=2`, after one Focus session completes naturally, clicking the button "Copy summary" on the History tab copies the text "Sessions: 1, Total focus: 00:02" to the clipboard and shows a toast "Copied to clipboard".
The streak display shows "Streak: 0" initially; with `/?focus=2`, after one Focus session completes naturally, it shows "Streak: 1".
With `/?focus=2`, after one Focus session completes naturally and a reload, the History tab shows an item with "Focus" and "00:02", and the streak display shows "Streak: 1".
